 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform full lines are tile separators. Replicate the most informative tile
    # across all tile positions, leaving the separator lines intact.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_tiles = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1)]
    col_tiles = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # Tiles must be congruent; choose the one with most non-background cells.
    tiles = []
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_tiles):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_tiles):
            if r1 > r0 and c1 > c0:
                vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
                tiles.append((sum(v != 0 and v != 3 for v in vals), ri, ci))
    if not tiles:
        return out
    _, sri, sci = max(tiles)
    sr0, sr1 = row_tiles[sri]
    sc0, sc1 = col_tiles[sci]
    source = [grid[r][sc0:sc1] for r in range(sr0, sr1)]
    sh, sw = len(source), len(source[0])
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_tiles):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_tiles):
            if ri == sri and ci == sci or r1-r0 != sh or c1-c0 != sw:
                continue
            for i in range(sh):
                for j in range(sw):
                    out[r0+i][c0+j] = source[i][j]
    return out
